subject: SOC 2 / pen test walkthrough — two-block compressed request
messages:
From: Alex Weston <aweston@finnova.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@pentestco.com>, security@finnova.com
Date: 2026-08-09T13:12:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 / pen test walkthrough — two-block compressed request

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the help here. We're running into a hard constraint for our engineering and infosec folks next week — the team is only available in two shorter windows rather than a single 90–120 minute block. Would Redwood be able to run this as two 45-minute blocks on the same day (one for control review + evidence Q&A, one for pen vendor scoping and live Q&A)? Our preference is:

- Option A: 2026-08-17 09:00–09:45 PDT (control + evidence) and 2026-08-17 13:00–13:45 PDT (pen scoping)
- Option B: 2026-08-18 16:00–16:45 PDT and 2026-08-18 20:00–20:45 PDT (if you need evening coverage)

Samir (cc) from our pen vendor will need a 30-minute pre-call before the second block to share scope. Also, legal wants a DPA signature step right after the walkthrough — I can circulate the DocuSign if you confirm.

If these two-blocks are a problem operationally, tell me what minimal coverage you can commit to and we'll try to adapt.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Finnova is trying to close timeline for Q3 compliance.

Best,
Alex
Head of Security Integrations
Finnova Bank
[Attachment: high_level_requirements.pdf (PDF)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Weston <aweston@finnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / pen test walkthrough — two-block compressed request

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the options. We can support a split format but need to lock a few things so the hands-on pen vendor portion doesn't get blocked by scheduling friction. Proposed plan:

1) Block 1 (control review + evidence): 2026-08-17 09:00–09:45 PDT — we will have our Security Ops lead and one engineering SME on the call.
2) Short 30-min vendor pre-call: 2026-08-17 11:30–12:00 PDT (Samir + Redwood pen ops) — quick handoff and scope sync.
3) Block 2 (pen scoping + live Q&A): 2026-08-17 13:00–13:45 PDT — our pen ops and one of our infra engineers.

Ben — can you confirm if the 11:30 pre-call and 13:00 pen scoping block work for your team? We also need Lauren from Legal to confirm the DPA review path and whether a redline is required before DocuSign.

Attachments I'm sending to the thread: evidence_mapping.xlsx (single-sheet mapping of typical SOC 2 controls and likely evidence; mark any items you want pre-uploaded), pen_scope.pdf (vendor-facing scope template). If Finnova wants us to pre-post evidence to a shared drive for the call, tell us which items and we'll put them in the Drive link (see metadata).

If the two-window day is confirmed I'll send calendar invites and a short run-of-show (10 minutes intro, 30 minutes control Q&A, 5 minutes buffer).

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[signature block]
[Attachment: evidence_mapping.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Weston <aweston@finnova.com>, Samir Patel <samir@pentestco.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / pen test walkthrough — two-block compressed request

Grace — confirmed on my side. I can staff both the 09:00 control block and 13:00 pen scoping block; Samir, the 11:30 pre-call looks good — we'll use a short Zoom breakout for vendor handoff.

Quick notes:
- We'll aim to pre-upload the following items into the Drive folder by EOD 2026-08-13: access logs sample (anonymized), config snapshots for our inference runtime, and the resiliency playbook excerpt.
- For the pen scope, Samir, please confirm whether you need a reproducible sample app or just interface-level endpoints — I can prepare the endpoint list if that helps.
- Lauren — do we need to attach the DPA draft to the calendar invite or circulate DocuSign in advance? If legal prefers an advance redline I'll schedule a 30-minute redline window the day prior.

Attaching: pen_scope.pdf (vendor scope template).

-Ben
Security Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pen_scope.pdf (PDF)]

From: Alex Weston <aweston@finnova.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@pentestco.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T10:47:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / pen test walkthrough — two-block compressed request

Thanks everyone — that schedule works for us. Final confirmations:

- Confirmed schedule: 2026-08-17 09:00–09:45 PDT (controls/evidence) + 11:30–12:00 PDT (vendor pre-call) + 13:00–13:45 PDT (pen scoping).
- Finnova will pre-share a short attendee roster and our prioritized control list by 2026-08-13.
- I'll initiate the DocuSign for the DPA right now and send the link to Lauren and Grace (see related link). If Lauren wants to redline first, let me know and I can pause the send.

Samir — if you need the reproducible sample app, request it by 2026-08-12 and we'll carve out a small window to hand it off. Ben — appreciate you prepping the endpoint list if Samir asks.

I'll wait for your calendar invites; otherwise, we'll consider this tentatively locked.

Alex
Head of Security Integrations, Finnova
[Attachment: attendee_roster.csv (CSV placeholder)]
